theater: 河南道滑州韋縣至洛口倉

battle.name: 翟讓起義
battle.theater: 河南道滑州韋縣至洛口倉
battle.brief: 大業六年（610），滑州韋縣的翟讓聚眾起事，以木筏沿黃河劫掠永濟渠漕船；後有李密來投，聯軍攻下洛口倉，成為瓦崗軍主體，隋廷遣張須陀鎮河南剿之。卡面羅馬方陣盾並非隋軍裝備，此處借它標示「盾」的位置：隋軍與瓦崗步卒都以木製大盾結陣遮蔽弓弩，防線靠盾與盾互相支撐，不是靠盾牌多厚。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方只有一方國家，就是隋朝；另一方是河南一帶自行聚集的起義武裝，首領是滑州韋縣人翟讓。隋朝方面，朝廷的討伐軍由河南行台與各郡的郡兵、縣兵組成，核心是虎威郎將張須陀所率的騎兵部隊以及河間郡丞樊子蓋督率的郡兵，另有從江都、洛陽兩處調發的援軍與大批被徵發的丁夫；地方上則依靠州縣官員臨時團練，兵源以農民為主，裝備多為自備的刀矛、弓箭與少量皮甲，戰時由郡丞、縣令直接率領。起義方起初完全不是軍隊，而是亡命與饑民組成的武裝團體，核心是翟讓的鄉里舊識、河上櫂夫、鹽販與散兵，無編制、無甲兵，靠劫掠永濟渠上的漕船維持生計，因此被隋廷稱為群盜，朝廷則以「群賊」名目下令討平。大業七年李密率關隴舊族身份投奔後，兩部合併為瓦崗軍，開始有軍令、糧秣與將校之制，李密設上四軍各領一軍之眾，翟讓仍居最高地位。整場衝突沒有任何外國勢力介入，是隋末農民起義浪潮中爆發最早、也最先取得大型官倉的一支；起義所據的河南，正是隋朝漕運與徵兵供應的樞紐所在。
countriesEn: Only one state fought on one side of this war, the Sui dynasty; on the other stood an armed uprising that formed on its own in the Henan region under Zhai Rang, a native of Wei county in Hua prefecture. On the Sui side the field forces sent against the rebels were drawn from the Henan circuit administration together with the militia of the commanderies and counties. Their core was the cavalry of the Tiger-Brave Gentleman-General Zhang Xutuo and the commandery troops commanded by the Administrator of Hejian, Fan Zigai, supplemented by reinforcements dispatched from Jiangdu and Luoyang and by a great number of corvée labourers; locally the court relied on officials in the prefectures and counties to organise improvised militia, whose soldiers were peasants for the most part, equipped with self-provided sabres, spears, bows and a little leather armour, and led in the field directly by the administrators and the magistrates. The rebel side was not an army in the beginning at all but a mass of fugitives and starving people: its core was Zhai Rang's village acquaintances, the boatmen of the river, salt smugglers and stray soldiers, with no organisation, no armour and no pay, kept alive by raiding the grain convoys on the Yongji Canal, so the court dismissed them as a band of robbers and ordered their suppression under the name of rebels. After Li Mi arrived in 611 with the standing of the old Guanzhong aristocracy, the two groups merged into the Wagang army; orders, provisions and a system of officers appeared, Li Mi created the Upper Four Armies, each with its own command, while Zhai Rang still stood at the head of all. No foreign power intervened at any point. This was a rebellion inside the Sui empire, but it was the earliest of the late-Sui uprisings to organise itself and the first to seize a large government granary; the province in which it rose, Henan, was precisely the hinge of the Sui state's grain transport and recruitment system.
people: 翟讓是這場起義的開創者，滑州韋縣人。《隋書》與《資治通鑑》對他早年的出身記載不一，或稱郡中小吏，或稱武勇之夫；他因犯法亡命，結納亡命之徒，聚集在黃河與白水一帶，靠木筏與漁船往來截奪永濟渠運往河北與遼東的漕船，把劫來的財貨分給徒眾，於是部眾漸多，隋廷屢發兵討而不能盡平。李密是關隴舊族，父祖世代仕隋，他本人曾任隋廷宿衛，熟悉禁軍編制與宮中要害；聞翟讓名後西來投奔，翟讓敬其才幹，與之結為兄弟，軍中議事竟讓李密居上席、翟讓居下席，這一條座位先後埋下日後的殺機。隋方主將張須陀是河南道最能戰的將領之一，善用虎騎，追擊瓦崗數戰皆勝，最終在大業十三年追擊途中戰歿於陣中，關於其死法有中流矢、遭伏襲等不同說法，隋軍失去主將後一併潰散，瓦崗得以乘勢取地。瓦崗內部另有房彥藻，他與翟讓素不相和，向李密進讒，促成李密起殺心；執行動手者為李密帳下蔡公德。此外，單雄信是瓦崗騎兵的重要指揮，隋將王世充其時任河南郡丞屯洛陽，與瓦崗長期對峙；至大業十四年，宇文化及引關內兵入洛陽，瓦崗最後的崩潰與他直接相關。
peopleEn: Zhai Rang was the founder of the uprising, a native of Wei county in Hua prefecture. The Sui Book and the Comprehensive Mirror differ about his early station, one calling him a minor clerk of the commandery, others presenting him as a man of arms; he fled into outlawry for breaking the law, gathered fugitives, and ranged along the Yellow River and the Bai water with rafts and fishing boats, intercepting the convoys that the Yongji Canal carried grain along towards Hebei and Liaodong, and shared the plunder among his followers, so that his band grew until the Sui court repeatedly sent troops against him without ever wiping him out. Li Mi was of the old Guanzhong aristocracy, his father and grandfather serving the Sui, and he himself had served as a palace guard, which gave him exact knowledge of the imperial guard establishment and of the sensitive points inside the palace; hearing of Zhai Rang's name he came west to join him, Zhai Rang respecting his ability and swearing brotherhood with him, and in the military council the seat of honour was given to Li Mi while Zhai Rang sat below, a precedence of seating that planted the seed of the murder to come. The Sui commander Zhang Xutuo was among the ablest generals the court had in Henan, skilled with his Tiger cavalry and victorious in several engagements against the Wagang forces; finally, in the thirteenth year of Daye, he was killed in action while pursuing them, accounts of his death differing, some saying he was struck by a stray arrow and others that he was ambushed, and the Sui army broke up after losing its commander, letting the Wagang seize ground. Inside the Wagang camp there was also Fang Yan'ao, already at odds with Zhai Rang, who slandered him to Li Mi and put the thought of killing him into Li Mi's head; the hand that carried it out was Li Mi's own subordinate Cai Gongde. Shan Xiongxin was an important commander of the Wagang cavalry; on the Sui side Wang Shicheng was then Administrator of Henan, garrisoned at Luoyang, in long confrontation with the Wagang; and in the fourteenth year of Daye Yu Wen Huaji led the troops from within the passes into Luoyang, and the final collapse of the Wagang was directly connected with him.
kits: 本卡所示是羅馬方陣盾（Scutum），公元前一世紀羅馬重裝步兵的標誌性裝備，凸面長方，盾緣彼此相扣，軍團的防線靠盾與盾互相咬合成立，靠整體而不是靠厚度。史實上它與隋代中原並無瓜葛，這張卡在這場戰役裡的位置是「盾」這個兵器的位置：隋軍與瓦崗步卒同樣以木製大盾配槊、弩使用，盾面蒙皮或釘革以擋流矢與火矢，臨陣時前排執盾遮蔽、後排以步弓箭與強弩從盾後射擊，即《隋書·兵志》所記隋軍步卒兼備甲、弩、槊、盾的編制。起義軍初期的裝備極為簡陋，據史載多以木棒、標槍、繩索與農具應手，兵卒往往不著甲胄，攻城器械亦不完備；直到攻下洛口倉、收羅隋廷留下的甲兵與弓弩，瓦崗才有條件為步卒配發盾牌與長槊。攻城一方用雲梯、巢車、火箭與穴地，防守一方在城門內以大盾、長槊與拒馬構成拒止線，攻守雙方對同一件「盾」的用法完全相反。與羅馬方陣盾相比，隋式盾牌形制更方更薄、幅面較窄，但共通處恰恰是：盾從來不是用來單打獨鬥的，而是讓整排人互相支撐，把射擊與衝撞的力量攤分到整條線上，這也是本卡借羅馬盾標示隋軍與瓦崗護盾邏輯之故。
kitsEn: The card shows the Roman scutum, the signature piece of the heavy infantry of the first century BC: a convex rectangle whose edges overlapped one another, so that a Roman line was made by shield against shield and stood by the whole rather than by the thickness of any single board. Historically it had nothing to do with the Sui heartland, and in this battle the card stands for the position of the shield as a weapon. The Sui soldiers and the Wagang infantry used wooden large shields together with the long spear and the crossbow; the shield face was covered with hide or studded with leather to turn away arrows and fire-arrows, and in the line the front rank carried the shields as cover while the rear shot bows and heavy crossbows from behind them, which is the establishment the Sui Book records for Sui infantry, who carried armour, crossbows, long spears and shields. The rebels began with the poorest equipment imaginable: wooden clubs, javelins, ropes and farm tools served them as weapons, their men often fought without armour, and their siege gear was incomplete; only after the fall of the Luokou granary and the collection of the armour and bows left behind by the Sui did the Wagang find it possible to issue shields and long spears to the foot. The besiegers used scaling ladders, siege towers, fire arrows and mine shafts, while the defenders at the gates used large shields, long spears and caltrops to bar the way; the same object, the shield, was therefore used in exactly opposite ways on the two sides. Compared with the Roman scutum, the Sui shield was squarer, thinner and narrower, but the common principle is exactly the one the card marks: a shield was never meant to fight alone but to let a whole rank brace one another, spreading the force of fire and of impact along the entire line.
tactics: 起義前期是一場水上的游擊戰。翟讓沒有攻城器械，也沒有能力與隋廷的郡兵正面對抗，因此把戰場放在黃河、白水與永濟渠的水面上：用木筏與漁船載兵，順流與逆流快速轉移，襲擊漕船、渡口與運鹽的船隊，遇隋朝巡河兵則散入蘆葦河汊，待官軍退去再出。夜間渡水、白日潛伏，時間壓在官軍巡河的間隔上，這是饑民武裝唯一能勝過正規郡兵的方式。李密來投之後，戰術的重心由劫掠轉為取糧。大業十三年瓦崗攻破洛口倉，取得倉中大批糧秣，隨即在洛水北岸築城立柵、設九都宮屯住，把糧倉變成據點，並以糧食招納河南饑民與散兵，隊伍由數千、數萬膨脹到數十萬。進攻方向則鎖定官軍的補給線與渡口，板渚、滑州、氾水一線的黃河渡河點是隋軍糧車必經之處，瓦崗屢次在這些地方設伏，張須陀死後官軍喪膽，瓦崗乘勢逐漸取下河南郡縣。面對張須陀的騎兵衝擊，瓦崗以步為主，只能靠據險結盾、列陣而進與夜襲分割來抵消騎兵的機動力，單雄信所部的騎兵是其中少數例外。攻城技術仍是短板：李密後來圍洛陽，曾用穴地之法挖地道進攻，守軍察覺後反從地道殺出，隋守軍得以反擊，說明起義軍攻城器械與工程仍然粗糙。瓦崗內部則靠分軍屯倉、各軍別儲糧秣與設將校職名維持秩序，避免單一倉儲被一次敗仗全部丟掉。
tacticsEn: The first phase of the uprising was a war of manoeuvre on the water. Zhai Rang had no siege engines and could not stand up to the Sui commandery troops in open field, so he put the battlefield on the Yellow River, the Bai water and the Yongji Canal: rafts and fishing boats carried his men, moving fast with and against the current, striking grain convoys, ferry crossings and salt convoys, and when the Sui river patrols came they scattered into the reeds and the backwater, emerging again once the patrols had gone. Crossing at night and lying low by day, they timed their moves to the gaps between the patrols; for a hungry mob this was the only way to beat regular troops. After Li Mi joined, the centre of gravity of the fighting shifted from plunder to supply. In the thirteenth year of Daye the Wagang broke into the Luokou granary, took the grain stored there, and then built a stockaded town on the north bank of the Luo river with the palace of Jiudu, turning the granary into a stronghold and drawing in the starving of Henan and the scattered soldiers with the promise of grain, so that a force of some thousands grew to tens of thousands and then to hundreds of thousands. Their attacks were directed at the supply line and the ferry crossings of the Sui army, for the crossings of the Yellow River at Ban Chu, at Hua prefecture and along the Fanshui had to be used by the Sui grain carts, and the Wagang ambushed at these points repeatedly; after Zhang Xutuo's death the Sui morale broke, and the Wagang took the commanderies of Henan one after another. Facing Zhang Xutuo's cavalry, the Wagang, mainly infantry, could only counter the mobility of the horse by holding ground, closing up behind shields, advancing in line and attacking at night in small bodies; the cavalry under Shan Xiongxin was one of the few exceptions. Siege work remained their weak point: when Li Mi later besieged Luoyang he drove a tunnel under the wall, but the defenders detected it and came out through the tunnel to strike back, showing that the rebels' siege equipment and engineering were still crude. Inside the army, order was kept by garrisoning the several armies in separate depots, each with its own stores of grain, and by a roster of officer titles, so that a single defeat could not wipe out all the provisions at once.
data: 關於兵數，諸史記載互有出入，只能取其量級。翟讓初起時眾數千，屬小股武裝；張須陀所部在隋朝鎮河南的官軍中規模最大，多記為數萬之眾，但同一時期亦有記作數千者，可見多為概數。李密、翟讓合流並取得洛口倉之後，瓦崗軍眾在《資治通鑑》中記為至數十萬，至大業十四年圍洛陽時仍是河南最大的武裝集團，與之相比，宇文化及所帶的關內兵與王世充所部的洛陽守軍都偏少。糧秣方面，洛口倉是隋朝為東征高句麗而設的總儲糧地，貯量以百萬石量級計，這一數字在《資治通鑑》與《隋書》之間有出入，只能視為量級，而瓦崗據此一度可支十數萬人數月之糧。時間線大致可考：大業六年（610）翟讓在滑州韋縣起兵並劫掠漕船；大業七年（611）李密來投，同年官軍在板渚一線受挫，該年天下大旱、穀價騰貴；大業十三年（617）瓦崗取洛口倉，張須陀戰歿，其年十二月冬至日李密殺翟讓；大業十四年（618）瓦崗圍洛陽不下，宇文化及入洛陽，李密敗亡。距離方面，韋縣至洛口倉陸路約四百餘里，洛口倉距洛陽城不足二十里，居高臨下、據水瞰城，故為必爭之地。
dataEn: On numbers the histories differ and only orders of magnitude can be used. Zhai Rang's first band numbered some thousands, a small armed group; Zhang Xutuo's command, the largest Sui force stationed in Henan, is usually given as tens of thousands, though the same period also records it as a few thousand, showing that the figures are rough. After Li Mi and Zhai Rang joined and took the Luokou granary, the Wagang host is recorded in the Comprehensive Mirror as reaching tens of thousands, and when it besieged Luoyang in the fourteenth year of Daye it was still the largest armed mass in Henan, while the troops from within the passes under Yu Wen Huaji and the Luoyang garrison under Wang Shicheng were both smaller. As for provisions, Luokou was the great Sui depot built to feed the campaigns against Goguryeo, and its stores are on the order of a million shi; that figure differs between the Comprehensive Mirror and the Sui Book and can only be read as an order of magnitude, yet the Wagang was able to feed several hundred thousand men for months on it. The sequence of events can be roughly reconstructed: in the sixth year of Daye (610) Zhai Rang rose at Wei county in Hua prefecture and began raiding the grain convoys; in the seventh year (611) Li Mi joined him, the Sui army was checked along the Ban Chu line in that same year, the year of a great drought and soaring grain prices; in the thirteenth year (617) the Wagang took the Luokou granary, Zhang Xutuo was killed, and in the twelfth month of that year, on the winter solstice, Li Mi killed Zhai Rang; in the fourteenth year (618) the Wagang failed to take Luoyang, Yu Wen Huaji entered the city, and Li Mi was destroyed. In distance: the road from Wei county to the Luokou granary runs about four hundred li, and Luokou lies less than twenty li from the walls of Luoyang, high above the water and looking down on the city, which is why it was fought over.
cause: 起義的直接背景是隋朝在大業年間的全面崩解。皇帝連年用兵：大業六年北征契丹失利，士卒死者以數十萬計；其後三次征討高句麗，每次傾國而出，轉運、屯糧、造船的丁夫動輒百萬，役期一延再延。與此同時，黃河兩岸連年水旱失收，大業七年天下大旱，穀價騰貴，饑民相食，民多逃亡為盜。隋朝的刑律對盜劫漕船與亡命者極重，觸法者往往沒入官府為奴，於是盜與官之間形成了一個越來越大的灰色地帶，地方豪強、流民與散兵就從這個地帶裡聚了起來。翟讓走的正是這條路：以亡命為首，挾河上之便，先取財貨以養眾，再以眾護財。深層次看，隋朝在河南一帶承受的壓力遠超別處，京師與東都的糧食大半靠永濟渠自河南轉運，兵源與役源也在河南，於是任何一支敢於截斷漕運、敢於吸收流民的武裝，都會立刻變成朝廷的頭號敵患。翟讓起義正是這樣一支隊伍，而李密的加入則為它補上了關隴舊族的兵法與謀略，使這場原本只是饑民暴動的衝突，一夜之間有了爭取天下的架子。
causeEn: The immediate background to the rising was the general collapse of the Sui in the Daye years. The emperor campaigned without end: the expedition against the Khitan in the sixth year of Daye ended in defeat with tens of thousands of soldiers dead, and the three campaigns against Goguryeo that followed took the whole realm out each time, with the labour of transporting grain, garrisoning depots and building ships running to millions of corvée hands, and the terms being extended again and again. At the same time the lands along the Yellow River suffered bad harvests year after year; in the seventh year of Daye there was a great drought throughout the realm, grain prices soared, the starving ate one another, and people fled in large numbers to become bandits. Sui law was brutally severe for anyone who raided a grain convoy or fled the jurisdiction, and those caught were commonly handed over to the state as slaves, so that a grey zone opened up between bandit and subject, and in that zone local magnates, vagrants and stray soldiers gathered. That was the road Zhai Rang took: fugitives at the head, using the river for advantage, taking wealth first to feed the band and then using the band to protect the wealth. More deeply, the pressure the Sui state bore in Henan was heavier than anywhere else, since the capital and the eastern capital drew most of their grain through the Yongji Canal out of Henan, and Henan also supplied the soldiers and the labour; any armed group willing to cut the grain route and to absorb the vagrants therefore became the court's first enemy, and that was exactly what the Wagang was. Li Mi's arrival added the strategy and the professional habits of the old Guanzhong aristocracy to it and in a single stroke turned what had been a hungry riot into an enterprise aiming at the empire.
impact: 這場起義是隋末十年亂世的開端之一。瓦崗軍是隋末三大起義軍中最先完成整編、最先控制大型糧倉的一支，它的興起直接削弱了隋朝在河南的統治，令朝廷連年投入的東征與漕運體系失去中樞。占據洛口，等於握住了京師與東都的咽喉；洛陽屢攻不下、糧道屢遭襲擊，隋廷只能靠從江都、洛陽臨時徵發與臨時團練來補，補不過來，隋朝便在起義爆發後第八年亡國。對瓦崗自身，翟讓的死是一次制度性的失敗：起義原是兩個集團的聯盟，一個是河南本地以亡命為主幹的江湖武裝，一個是關隴舊族加入後帶來的建制與謀略，李密以一次宮中宴席除掉盟友，權力集中了，軍隊卻從此只聽一人，宿怨、舊部與猜忌一起累積，兩年後李密兵敗洛陽時，舊部崩散得極快，從瓦崗降唐、降夏、散為盜者比比皆是。對後世，隋亡之後唐承隋制，均田、府兵、漕運的基本框架被延續，而大量隋末起義軍的亡命農民被編入唐初軍籍，也在不知不覺中改變了關中兵制的兵源結構：唐初府兵與蕃兵的組成，在相當程度上正是隋末亂後人口流散、軍隊解散、重新集編的產物。
impactEn: This uprising was one of the openings of the ten years of disorder at the end of the Sui. The Wagang was the first of the three great late-Sui rebel armies to complete its reorganisation and the first to seize a large government granary; its rise stripped Henan of Sui control and cut into the transport and recruitment system on which the dynasty had spent everything. Holding Luokou was holding the throat of the capital and of the eastern capital: Luoyang could not be taken and the grain road was raided again and again, so the court could only scrape men together from Jiangdu and Luoyang through fresh levies and improvised militia, and the Sui fell eight years after the rising began. For the Wagang itself, the death of Zhai Rang was an institutional failure. The revolt had begun as a league of two groups, one the Henan riverine armed mass built on fugitives, the other the organisation and the strategy brought in by the old Guanzhong aristocracy through Li Mi; Li Mi removed his partner at a banquet in the palace, power was concentrated, and from that day the army obeyed one man only, with old grudges, old retainers and mutual suspicion accumulating together, so that when Li Mi was beaten before Luoyang two years later his host dissolved with startling speed, Wagang men surrendering to the Tang, to Xia or scattering as bandits being common. For later ages, the Tang took over the Sui institutions after the dynasty fell, and the basic framework of equal-field allocation, the fubing militia and the canal transport was carried on, while the enormous numbers of peasants drawn into the late-Sui rebel armies were mustered into the army registers of the early Tang, quietly altering the composition of the armies of Guanzhong: the fubing and the foreign contingents of the early Tang were in good measure the product of the population upheaval and of the dissolution and remustering of armies after the chaos at the end of the Sui.
result: 翟讓起義本身的結局，是一場由自己人收場的勝利。大業十三年冬，李密在洛口九都宮設宴，翟讓赴宴而醉，房彥藻先前進讒、蔡公德在側，李密遂命人將翟讓殺死，隨後以禮葬之，追贈上柱國、瞿陽公，以安撫舊部；瓦崗軍則由李密單獨掌握，李密自立為魏公，置元帥府與軍府官屬，擁眾數十萬，聲勢為隋末之最。然而高峰不過兩年：大業十四年李密大舉圍洛陽，攻城不克，反被宇文化及乘虛引關內兵入洛陽、廢黜皇泰主楊侑，瓦崗主力隨即崩潰，李密北走，途中在牛口、熊耳山一帶為追兵所殺，一說為部下所害，諸說並存。瓦崗殘部或散歸山林為盜，或降於唐、李淵、竇建德，其中如秦叔寶、程知節一類人隨後成了唐軍骨幹。從大歷史看，這場起義完成了它的任務：它把隋朝最後的秩序徹底打破，替唐室鋪平了中原，也替後世留下一個明白的教訓——把起義當事業來經營的聯盟，若只剩下奪權而沒有整合，最終會從內部散架，比官軍的進攻更致命。
resultEn: The outcome of the rising of Zhai Rang was a victory undone by his own people. In the winter of the thirteenth year of Daye, Li Mi spread a banquet at the palace of Jiudu in Luokou; Zhai Rang came, drank, and was killed on the spot, after Fang Yan'ao's earlier slander and with Cai Gongde at hand; Li Mi then buried him with honour and posthumously granted him the rank of Upper Pillar of State and the title of Duke of Quyang to quiet his old followers, and the Wagang army fell entirely under Li Mi, who proclaimed himself Duke of Wei, set up a marshal's headquarters and the offices of the army, mustered hundreds of thousands, and for a moment held the highest place of any Sui rebel. But the peak lasted only two years. In the fourteenth year of Daye Li Mi threw his whole army against Luoyang and failed to take it; Yu Wen Huaji rode in with the troops from within the passes, deposed the emperor-elect Yang You, and the Wagang main force collapsed at once. Li Mi fled north and was killed on the way by the pursuing troops around Niukou and Xiong'er Mountain, according to one account by his own men, and the several versions do not agree. The remnants of the Wagang either scattered into the hills as bandits or entered the service of the Tang under Li Yuan, of Dou Jiande and of others, and men such as Qin Shubao and Cheng Zhijie became the backbone of the Tang army. In the larger view the rising did its work: it broke the last order of the Sui altogether, levelled the plains for the Tang, and left later ages a plain lesson, that a league turned into an enterprise, once it keeps only the seizure of power and forgets how to hold people together, will come apart from within far more fatally than any attack by the government forces.
